d: What does a samosa have to do with American politics? Meet the 'Samosa Caucus' — the informal group of Indian-American lawmakers in the U.S. House of Representatives. From key congressional committees to the growing influence of Indian-American voters, discover how this group became a symbol of political representation on Capitol Hill. With the 2026 U.S. midterm elections approaching, two members are set to leave the House. What does that mean for Indian-American political power in Washington? Cary Johnston brings you the details on Firstpost America.
